t.question: CAN A FREE VOICE ASSISTANT UNDERSTAND TELUGU?
t.said: ఆర్డర్ నలభై నాలుగు పదిహేడు, నా ఇయర్‌ఫోన్స్ రిటర్న్ చేశాను. నా రిఫండ్ వచ్చిందా?
t.saidEn: "Order 4417, I returned my earphones. Has my refund come?"
t.heardHi: आल्डर नालभाई, नालगु पदिहेडु, ना एर फोंस रिटन चेसानु।
t.gloss: "Order 4417, I returned my earphones. Has my refund come?"
t.heardE: "I cancelled order 4611. Where is my money?"

yt.chapter: Our test, the best free result
yt.title: Our test, the best free result

lines.text: Our test: ten customers, in computer voices. [1] English: three numbers came out like prices. <pause 0.5> [2] Telugu, small free model: Telugu words, in Hindi letters.
lines.show: Our test: 10 customers, in computer voices. English: 3 numbers came out like prices. <pause 0.5> Telugu, small free model: Telugu words, in Hindi letters.
lines.tts: Our test: ten customers, in computer voices. English: three numbers came out like prices.
lines.tts2: Telugu, small free model: Telugu words, in Hindi letters.

lines.text: When it couldn't read the number, [1] the AI made one up: one, two, three, four, five. Eight times in fifty tries.
lines.show: When it couldn't read the number, the AI made one up: 1, 2, 3, 4, 5. 8 times in 50 tries.

lines.text: Best free result: a bigger model, translating to English first. [1] Five of ten. <pause 0.5> [2] About thirty-five seconds an answer on our computer, and twenty of that is the mouth.
